def moon_phase_prediction(n, moon_sizes):
    if n == 1:
        return -1
    
    current_size = moon_sizes[-1]
    previous_size = moon_sizes[-2]
    
    if current_size > previous_size:
        return "UP"
    elif current_size < previous_size:
        return "DOWN"
    else:
        return -1

print(result)

def determine_moon_direction(n, a):
    if n == 1:
        return -1
    if a[n - 1] > a[n - 2]:
        return "UP"
    if a[n - 1] < a[n - 2]:
        return "DOWN"
    return -1
